'''Ian Ross''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Bridgewater tournament]] on 23 February 2001 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|CCT w/ Scum and Jabba's Prize]], according to Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1777">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-bridgewater-ma-2-23-01d1777/ bridgewater-ma-2-23-01], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-bridgewater-ma-2-23-01d1777/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
